scripts.name: pop
above: Where the snake ate: sparks fly out and are gone.

scripts.name: blink
above: Words: the prompt of the title blinks, the logo sways.

scripts.name: sway
scripts.note: entry: the title show starts it

params.name: best
params.note: the game gives it what it kept

params.name: length
params.note: the snake grows a cell a step until it is so long

scripts.name: crashed
scripts.note: GAME OVER; a start in its first second is not taken

above: The game itself as an actor: its phase (what moves now: PH_*), the score, the best, the length the snake is
to grow to, how fast it goes, when a star comes, the words it shows (GAME OVER: the game draws it in the zone
message). The game moves the snake a cell every speed ms and tells this actor what the head found and where it
turned. Its signals: SIG_NUMBERS the numbers changed, SIG_OVER the game is over (the best is kept), SIG_STAR a star
comes (a cell of the game's choosing), SIG_STAR_GONE it is gone (the timer star), SIG_NEW a new game (the game lays

dialogs.name: pause
dialogs.text:
dialog pause
roles play PLAY
game PLAY
style menu
pause
    say game "PAUSE  Score {score}  Best {best}"
choose play
    "Continue" -> resume
    "New game" -> restart
label resume
    end
label restart
    tell play restart
    end
